name: Gotokuji
tagline: Shinjuku in 16 minutes and Shibuya in 18 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Odakyu and Tokyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 16 minutes to Shinjuku, 18 minutes to Shibuya and 44 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 35.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.5 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 35.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 32.9 m to 40.4 m, a difference of 7.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 17 clinics and 16 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is うめとぴあ, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 児玉新生会児玉経堂病院, about 18 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Odakyu Odawara Line and Tokyu Setagaya Line. The lines are split between operators (Odakyu runs 1 line and Tokyu runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Odakyu Odawara Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 世田谷代田→下北沢, which this station is not on. Tokyu Setagaya Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000, 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Umegaoka is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Gotokuji is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Gotokuji.

neighbours.lead: Miyanosaka is ahead on quiet, but Gotokuji is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 9 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Gotokuji.

noiseSources: 瀬田貫井線 (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
